proof_scope: static goal-helper skill contract validation, including immutable-goal explain-project closure gate

claims.proves: goal-helper declares explain-project/ops-excalidraw composition and contains a fail-closed immutable-goal closure gate requiring source-bound explainability proof before MET/DONE closure.
claims.does_not_prove: any target project's immutable goal is met, any live explain-project package is complete, or any Excalidraw board renders to approved SVG.

capability_claims.description: Immutable-goal closure is blocked unless explain-project validates, answers load-bearing questions, has editable Excalidraw boards, and binds diagrams back to source/docstrings.

cases.name: immutable-goal-explain-gate-present
command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
text = Path('../SKILL.md').read_text()
required = [
    'No immutable goal can be marked `MET`, `DONE`, or accepted as closed until',
    '$explain-project validate',
    '$explain-project ask',
    '$ops-excalidraw',
    'Code points back to diagrams',
    'NOT_MET',
    '- explain-project',
    '- ops-excalidraw',
]
missing = [item for item in required if item not in text]
if missing:
    raise SystemExit(f'missing immutable-goal gate text: {missing}')
print('IMMUTABLE_GOAL_EXPLAIN_GATE_PRESENT')
PY

cases.name: missing-explain-gate-fails-closed
command:
TMP=$(mktemp -d); cp -R .. "$TMP/goal-helper"; TMPD="$TMP" python3 - <<'PY'
import os
from pathlib import Path
p = Path(os.environ['TMPD']) / 'goal-helper' / 'SKILL.md'
text = p.read_text()
start = text.index('## Immutable Goal Closure Gate')
end = text.index('## Proof Surface Guide')
p.write_text(text[:start] + text[end:])
mutated = p.read_text()
required = ['No immutable goal can be marked `MET`', '$explain-project validate', '$ops-excalidraw']
missing = [item for item in required if item not in mutated]
if missing != required:
    raise SystemExit(f'unexpected missing set: {missing}')
print('MISSING_EXPLAIN_GATE_DETECTED')
PY
